[GOOS:windows] skip 'requires a non-Windows host'
env GOPROXY=off
env GOSUMDB=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOWORK=off

cd m
logos eject -o out
exists out/platform_windows.go

cd out
env GOOS=windows
env GOARCH=amd64
env CGO_ENABLED=0
go build -mod=readonly ./...

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/inactivesupport

go 1.27

-- m/anchor.lgo --
package inactivesupport

-- m/platform_windows.lgo --
package inactivesupport

import "logos/sync"

func PlatformValue() int {
	var locked sync.Locked[int]
	var result int
	locked.WithLock(func(value *int) {
		*value = 42
		result = *value
	})
	return result
}
